# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D3 (border defence). Generated by gen_round4_border.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Fourth round counter: one event fired by this track's scheduler (guarded, r10 lesson 1).
oe_tbd_count = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. pressure
# Theme scope. Removes the pressure of a theme that is not (or no longer) a march.
oe_tbd_clear_pressure = {
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_pressure
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_n_war
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_n_hostile
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_n_strong
}
# Theme scope (a march). Contract: recomputes var:oe_tbd_pressure now. Each foreign owner next to a border jurisdiction
# location counts once (temporary list oe_tbd_nb, emptied again at the end so several calls in one effect stay apart).
oe_tbd_theme_calc = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ct
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tbd_tarmy value = army_size }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_war value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_hostile value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_strong value = 0 }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_border = yes }
        every_neighbor_location = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { is_in_list = oe_tbd_nb } } }
            owner = { add_to_temporary_list = oe_tbd_nb }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_tbd_nb
        save_scope_as = oe_tbd_nn
        if = {
            limit = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
            scope:oe_tbd_ct = { change_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_war add = 1 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_tbd_hostile = yes c:BYZ = { is_rival_of = scope:oe_tbd_nn } } }
            scope:oe_tbd_ct = { change_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_hostile add = 1 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { army_size > scope:oe_tbd_tarmy }
            scope:oe_tbd_ct = { change_variable = { name = oe_tbd_n_strong add = 1 } }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = { list = oe_tbd_nb remove_from_list = oe_tbd_nb }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_pressure value = oe_tbd_pressure_calc }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. border events
# Theme scope. Records one border event (at most 2 in 12 months).
oe_tbd_note = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tbd_ev_a } } set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_ev_a months = 12 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_ev_b months = 12 } }
}
# Theme scope. Queues the kind of border event.
oe_tbd_queue_kind = {
    random_list = {
        50 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tbd_fortified } } set_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid }
        25 = { trigger = { has_country_modifier = oe_tbd_fortified } set_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid }
        25 = { trigger = { has_country_modifier = oe_tbd_fortified } set_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat }
        25 = { trigger = { has_variable = oe_tbd_raided } set_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee }
        25 = { trigger = { always = yes } set_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect }
    }
}
# Location scope. The country behind a border event: a neighbour at war with Byzantium, else a hostile one, else any
# foreign neighbour. Saved as scope:oe_tbd_ev_foe (may stay unset).
oe_tbd_find_foe = {
    random_neighbor_location = { limit = { owner ?= { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_foe } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_ev_foe } }
        random_neighbor_location = { limit = { owner ?= { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } oe_tbd_hostile = yes } } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_foe } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_ev_foe } }
        random_neighbor_location = { limit = { owner ?= { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_foe } }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The location of a border event: an exposed jurisdiction location, else any (console tests).
oe_tbd_pick_loc = {
    random_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ oe_tbd_exposed = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_loc }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_ev_loc } }
        random_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_loc }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The peasants flee from a raided location if there is one.
oe_tbd_pick_loc_raided = {
    random_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_tbd_raid_loc has_location_modifier = oe_tbd_raid_light_loc } }
        save_scope_as = oe_tbd_ev_loc
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_ev_loc } } oe_tbd_pick_loc = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. When nothing is queued: the march with the highest pressure >= 40 (under its yearly cap) rolls pressure / 5 %.
oe_tbd_roll = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_tbd_events_allowed = yes
            NOT = { any_subject = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } }
            any_subject = { oe_tbd_can_strike = yes }
        }
        ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_can_strike = yes } order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key save_scope_as = oe_tbd_pick }
        scope:oe_tbd_pick ?= { random = { chance = oe_tbd_chance oe_tbd_queue_kind = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. At most one event of this track a month for the whole empire.
oe_tbd_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tbd_events_allowed = yes }
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.5 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.1 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.4 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.2 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tbd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tbd add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.3 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, every January. Hired mercenaries may make trouble.
oe_tbd_january = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tbd_events_allowed = yes }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_country_modifier = oe_tbd_hired NOT = { has_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc } NOT = { has_variable = oe_te_managed } }
            random = { chance = 10 set_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_tbd_byz_pulse).
oe_tbd_byz_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_tbd_january = yes }
    if = { limit = { is_ai = yes OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 7 } } oe_tbd_ai = yes }
    oe_tbd_roll = yes
    oe_tbd_dispatch = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. actions (BYZ scope; scope:oe_tbd_act_theme is the march)
# Location scope. One theme soldier unit of the current age for scope:oe_tbd_u_owner.
oe_tbd_unit_here = {
    if = { limit = { current_age = age_1_traditions } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_II owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_III owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_IV owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_V owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_VI owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
    else = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:oe_tbd_u_owner } }
}
# Theme scope. $n$ theme soldier units at the seat.
oe_tbd_units = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tbd_u_owner
    capital ?= { while = { count = $n$ oe_tbd_unit_here = yes } }
}
oe_tbd_fortify_do = {
    add_gold = -100
    scope:oe_tbd_act_theme = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tbd_fortified years = 10 mode = replace }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_fortify_cd years = 10 }
        set_variable = oe_tbd_job_fort
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.9
}
oe_tbd_levy_do = {
    add_gold = -50
    scope:oe_tbd_act_theme = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tbd_levy years = 5 mode = replace }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_levy_cd years = 5 }
        set_variable = oe_tbd_job_u2
        set_variable = oe_tbd_job_calc
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.9
}
oe_tbd_hire_do = {
    add_gold = -40
    scope:oe_tbd_act_theme = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tbd_hired years = 5 mode = replace }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_hire_cd years = 5 }
        set_variable = oe_tbd_job_calc
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.9
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. AI (BYZ scope, January and July)
oe_tbd_ai = {
    # castles for the march under the highest pressure, with 3 x the cost in the treasury
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= 300 any_subject = { oe_tbd_fortify_target = yes oe_tbd_hot = yes } }
        ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_fortify_target = yes oe_tbd_hot = yes } order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_act_theme } oe_tbd_fortify_do = yes }
    }
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
    # border troops where the pressure is >= 60
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= 150 any_subject = { oe_tbd_levy_target = yes has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure var:oe_tbd_pressure >= 60 } }
        random = {
            chance = 50
            ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_levy_target = yes has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure var:oe_tbd_pressure >= 60 } order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_act_theme } oe_tbd_levy_do = yes }
        }
    }
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
    # mercenaries where the pressure is >= 60, never for a theme with loyalty below 40
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= 120 any_subject = { oe_tbd_hire_ai_target = yes has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure var:oe_tbd_pressure >= 60 } }
        random = {
            chance = 30
            ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_hire_ai_target = yes has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure var:oe_tbd_pressure >= 60 } order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_act_theme } oe_tbd_hire_do = yes }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod buttons and console)
# BYZ scope. The province under test: var oe_tbd_test_theme (the dev mod copies var:oe_dev_t into it), else a random march.
oe_tbd_test_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tbd_test_theme ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_tbd_test_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_tbd_tt }
    }
    else = {
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_frontier = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tbd_tt }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_tt } } random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tbd_tt } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tbd_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_test_theme value = scope:oe_tbd_tt } }
    }
}
# The test province becomes a march if needed, with pressure 80 (the next monthly pulse recomputes it).
oe_tbd_test_set = {
    oe_tbd_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_ts_frontier = yes } } oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_pressure value = 80 }
    }
}
# Fire one border event on the test province (any pending queue is cleared first).
oe_tbd_test_merc = { oe_tbd_test_pick = yes every_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc } oe_tbd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.5 }
oe_tbd_test_raid = { oe_tbd_test_pick = yes every_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid } oe_tbd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.1 }
oe_tbd_test_beat = { oe_tbd_test_pick = yes every_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat } oe_tbd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.4 }
oe_tbd_test_flee = { oe_tbd_test_pick = yes every_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee set_variable = { name = oe_tbd_raided months = 24 } } oe_tbd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.2 }
oe_tbd_test_defect = { oe_tbd_test_pick = yes every_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect } oe_tbd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tbd.3 }
# Recompute the pressure of every march now.
oe_tbd_test_calc = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_frontier = yes } oe_tbd_theme_calc = yes }
        else = { oe_tbd_clear_pressure = yes }
    }
}
# The scheduler once without the monthly roll (the hottest march gets an event if one is allowed).
oe_tbd_test_force = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_subject = { oe_tbd_queued = yes } } any_subject = { oe_tbd_can_strike = yes } }
        ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_tbd_can_strike = yes } order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key save_scope_as = oe_tbd_pick }
        scope:oe_tbd_pick ?= { oe_tbd_queue_kind = yes }
    }
    oe_tbd_dispatch = yes
}
# The AI path once (needs the gold and a fitting march).
oe_tbd_test_ai = { oe_tbd_ai = yes }
# Clear cooldowns, yearly caps, queues and the raid mark of the test province (modifiers stay until they expire).
oe_tbd_test_reset = {
    oe_tbd_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_tbd_tt ?= {
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_fortify_cd
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_levy_cd
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_hire_cd
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_ev_a
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_ev_b
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_raided
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee
        remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect
    }
}
